semantic_content.answer: Conditionally, 96 units were originally shipped and 93 usable units remain: 12 cartons × 8 units per carton = 96, then 96 − 3 damaged units = 93. This requires the dispatch, packing, and receiving records to concern one shipment and the 3 damaged units to be included among those 96. The supplied records do not independently establish that linkage.
